title: Hub & spoke under review
scenario: "Architecture review tomorrow: prove the spoke cannot be reached from the internet except through Front Door and the operator IP, and that private DNS resolves in both VNets." — Lead architect
mission: Produce the network evidence pack and explain the NSG and peering design.

steps.title: Peering
steps.command: az network vnet peering list -g rg-mfs-hub-lab --vnet-name vnet-mfs-hub-lab -o table

steps.title: NSG
steps.detail: List the AKS NSG rules and explain the order.
steps.command: az network nsg rule list -g rg-mfs-portal-lab --nsg-name nsg-mfs-aks-lab -o table

steps.title: Private DNS links
steps.detail: Each private zone must be linked to hub and spoke.
steps.command: az network private-dns link vnet list -g rg-mfs-hub-lab -z privatelink.vaultcore.azure.net -o table

steps.title: Answer the reviewer
steps.detail: Is peering transitive? If a second spoke peers with the hub, can it reach this spoke?

criteria.text: Hub↔spoke peering is Connected in both directions
NSG has Front Door (100), operator IP (110) and deny Internet (4000) rules
Both private DNS zones are linked to the hub and spoke VNets

expectedResult: A short evidence pack you could paste into a design review.
recovery: If a link or peering is missing, it is drift: plan + apply 10-foundation.
dont: Do not change NSG rules in the portal
hints: Peering is two resources, one per side.
Private DNS zones live in the hub and are linked to every VNet that must resolve them.

interview.question: Walk me through hub & spoke: why private DNS zones in the hub, and is peering transitive?
followUps: Hub & spoke vs one big VNet?
How many VNet IPs does a pod use with CNI Overlay?

debrief: Peering is non-transitive: spoke-to-spoke needs a hub router (Firewall/NVA) or direct peering. NSG rules are evaluated by priority, allow-specific before deny-broad. Private DNS zones centralised in the hub are linked to each VNet so private endpoints resolve consistently.

checker.plan: Read-only: az network vnet peering list, az network nsg rule list, az network private-dns link vnet list.
